name: Persuasion Engineering: 14 daily drills
note: Influence = the day's drill plus the usual 5 owner messages. Learn = read the card, write a one-line takeaway, do the try-today action.

days.influence: Write the 5 feelings an owner might want from a website. Message 5 owners, aiming at the feeling you think matters most.
Write 10 openers that start with the owner, not you. Send 5 different ones to 5 owners. Note which get replies.
Before each of 5 messages, copy one exact phrase from the owner's own posts or bio and use it back.
Play-back drill: 5 minutes with a friend, say their wants back in their exact words until they say yes. Then message 5 owners.
Write 8 questions for owners. Put one in each of 5 messages (for example: how do customers place orders right now?).
Chat with 3 warm prospects. Goal: get them talking and play it back. No pitching. Then message 5 new owners.
Review: count replies per opener, keep the best 2. Message 5 owners using only those.
Ask 3 people about a purchase they love and one they regret. Write the pattern. Message 5 owners.
Write your top 8 worries with an early-answer line for each. Use one early line in each of 5 messages.
Write 3 replies to 'let me think about it' that ask what is behind it and set a date. Role-play once. Message 5 owners.
GATE BOSS: have 5 real conversations and end each with a small next-step ask. After a yes, say only logistics.
Voice day: record 3 slow voice notes from the chest, send them to prospects. Message 5 owners.
Do the 60-second recall before each of 3 calls. Make 3 calls. Note how each felt.
Ask every friendly contact who else should see this. Review the 14 days: keep the 3 things that worked best.

cards.title: You sell feelings, not things
cards.idea: Nobody wants a website. They want the feeling it gives them: pride, fewer repeated questions, looking serious next to bigger shops.
cards.tryToday: Ask one owner which feeling matters most. Do not guess.

cards.title: Get their full attention first
cards.idea: If they are not paying attention, nothing else counts. Open with something about them, short and a little unexpected.
cards.tryToday: Rewrite your first line so it is about their shop, not you.

cards.title: Listen to the exact words
cards.idea: People tell you what they want in their own words. Looks good means show it. Sounds right means explain it. Feels right means let them try it.
cards.tryToday: Underline their key words in one chat and use those same words back.

cards.title: Say it back in their words
cards.idea: After 4 to 6 things, list them back in their words and order until you hear: yes, exactly.
cards.tryToday: Play back what you heard once today. Did they say yes?

cards.title: Ask for exactly what you need
cards.idea: Ask direct questions. Echo their last word as a question. Give something back for every few questions.
cards.tryToday: Echo one word today and see how much more they tell you.

cards.title: Make them feel understood
cards.idea: Copy a little of how they talk (length, language, mood), then lead. Show understanding by what you do, not by saying I understand.
cards.tryToday: Before each reply, check: is mine about as long and as warm as theirs?

cards.title: Work backwards from the end
cards.idea: Steps: attention, rapport, find what they want, present in their words, answer worries early, close, make it stick.
cards.tryToday: After each chat, mark which step it stopped at.

cards.title: Help them decide in a way they will be glad about
cards.idea: Ask about a purchase they love and one they regret. Match the way they decide when they get it right. Never push what they cannot afford.
cards.tryToday: Ask one person the love-versus-regret question.

cards.title: Answer worries before they say them
cards.idea: You know the usual objections. Mention them early, calmly, with a fair reframe.
cards.tryToday: Use one early-answer line in a message today.

cards.title: Find out when they will decide
cards.idea: I am going to decide can stay in the future forever. When they say let me think, ask what they are thinking about and agree a date.
cards.tryToday: Ask: what would you need to see to feel sure? Then fix a date.

cards.title: Test for the close, then stop talking
cards.idea: Ask small are-you-ready questions all through. When they say yes, stop selling. Then ask who else should see this.
cards.tryToday: End every chat with a small next step.

cards.title: Start from your own state and voice
cards.idea: Your mood spreads. Speak slower, lower, from the chest. Recall a strong moment before you call.
cards.tryToday: Do the 60-second recall before your next call.
